name: Enterprise Document, Knowledge and Terminology
constraints: Every assertion has one editable master: intrinsic concept facts are concept-owned, release-scoped vocabulary facts are scheme-owned, and assertions about an external subject are binding-model-owned; all cross-model views are derived and read-only.

WM-REC-001 owns stable record identity, immutable versions, instantiations, custody, retention and disposition; Knowledge Article is a governed documentary-form value on a record and Document Revision is record-owned.
WM-KNW-006 owns concept IRI, intension, intrinsic definitions, designation inventory, concept-level designation acceptability and global retirement, merge, split, redirect and tombstone semantics.

WM-KNW-018 owns scheme identity, immutable releases, release-scoped membership, top-concept status, hierarchy, collections, facets, arrays, scheme notes and scheme-local preferred, admitted, deprecated or withdrawn designation selection.
A cross-scheme mapping is one immutable assertion mastered on its declared source release and pins both source and target scheme releases; the target side exposes only a derived read-only view.
Intrinsic genus or differentia definitions remain concept-owned; scheme-local scope and editorial notes remain release-owned and cannot overwrite or contradict intrinsic definitions.

A concept may exist with zero scheme memberships and retain an intrinsically acceptable citable designation; later membership, preference or withdrawal is an append-only scheme-release assertion and never changes concept identity.

WM-XCT-020 masters classification of an external subject and pins subject identity, concept IRI, scheme IRI and exact scheme release; copied labels are display-only and label-only classification is invalid.
Knowledge Article genre or documentary form is referenced through an exact governed vocabulary release and is never an ISO 1087 designation or record identity.

A URL, file, path or carrier is a location or instantiation and never record identity; a move never changes record or version, while changed content or a changed declared significant property occasions a separate fixing event and new version.
Digest proves byte state and never record, version or concept identity; equal digests merge nothing and a mismatch raises an integrity event rather than silent repair.

Lexical equality never establishes concept identity; identical intension may retain multiple sourced definitions only with explicit context discriminators and precedence rules, while differing essential characteristics require distinct concepts.

Definitions preserve source, provenance, language, context, status, access scope and dispute state; definitions receive no independently resolvable identifier in this contour, and disputed never means deprecated or redirected.
Concept retirement is global and preserves resolvability, tombstone and identifier non-reuse; scheme-local withdrawal affects only that release and never globally deprecates the concept.

Published record versions and scheme releases are append-only, never renumbered and never silently repointed; changes create successor versions or releases and supersession never authorizes destruction.
holds: WM-REC-001, WM-KNW-006 and WM-KNW-018 remain non-canonical reviewable drafts and this profile cannot promote ahead of them.
WM-KNW-006 and WM-KNW-018 need reciprocal scope and relationship amendments that remove dual mastership of definitions, designations, membership, hierarchy and mappings.
WM-KNW-006 bound-release cardinality must permit a scheme-less concept or define a concept-register release.
WM-KNW-002 versus WM-KNW-018 parentage and the reversed WM-XCT-020 relationship remain unresolved registry holds.
WM-XCT-020 remains a reference rather than a base pending parentage resolution, so exact classification-release fixtures are research evidence only.
Mapping master direction, concept-level designation acceptability, definition-level access and dispute semantics, and exact classification-release pins are not yet ratified in the base contracts.
Licensed standards remain alignment evidence only until exact editions and usable clause crosswalks are pinned.
Independent assertion and decision identity remains delegated to EM-KNW-02 and is a scope boundary rather than a publication blocker.
Declarative fixtures are reviewable scenarios; no executable runtime semantics or fixture execution is claimed.
